title: Integrated adsorption–catalysis design enabling high-performance sodium–sulfur batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00531K, Review Article
Xinghao Zhang, Wanjie Gao, Yufan Chen, Yi Peng, Xi Liu, Xiaohu Yang, Xiaosong Xiong, Jie Wang, Yang Liu, Ao Jia, Yinxu Lu, Yuping Wu, Jiarui He
This review details the working mechanism of adsorption–catalysis synergy in RT Na–S batteries and systematically discusses the latest progress and strategies in enhancing adsorption–catalysis synergistic effects in RT Na–S batteries.
